verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents collecting all three signals in one OpenTelemetry-native platform: traces with flamegraphs and attribute search, logs from many sources, and metrics including Prometheus and trace-derived APM metrics. Its dashboards let you drill down from any panel into the underlying logs and traces, which supports pivoting with shared context. Missing for 10: explicit docs on direct trace-to-log correlation (e.g., by trace ID) outside dashboard drill-down, and independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-signal pivoting.
